definitions.explanation: Something that will never perish, be destroyed, or fade away. Used for achievements, spirit, legacy, and similar abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: {不滅|ふめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不滅|ふめつ}だ。

ベートーヴェン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{愛|あい}される→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧{不滅|ふめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Beethoven's music is an immortal art loved by people across the ages.

notes:
FORMATION: {不|ふ} (not, non-) + {滅|めつ} (destroy, perish). Literally 'not perishing.'

USAGE: {不滅|ふめつ} is used as a no-adjective ({不滅|ふめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧) or as a predicate ({不滅|ふめつ}だ). It has a literary and elevated tone, commonly used for praising lasting achievements or enduring qualities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不滅|ふめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: immortal masterpiece
- {不滅|ふめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧: imperishable achievements
- {不滅|ふめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: indestructible spirit
- {不滅|ふめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: unbreakable record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不滅|ふめつ}: imperishable, eternal (literary)
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧: eternity, forever (more general)
- {不朽|ふきゅう}: immortal, everlasting (similar literary register)
- ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧: permanent, perpetual
